# CityClick (cityclick.com) — Full Methodology & Commercial Underwriting Knowledge Base

## 1. Architectural Mission
CityClick provides deterministic, source-cited commercial real estate and municipal intelligence for 1,500+ US cities.

## 2. Mathematical Formulations

### 2.1 ECDF Mid-Rank Percentile
PercentileRank(x_i, X) = round(100 * (count(x < x_i) + 0.5 * count(x == x_i)) / N)

### 2.2 Viability Score Components (0–100)
1. Purchasing Power (25% Weight):
   PP = round(0.70 * PercentileRank(MedianHouseholdIncome) + 0.30 * PercentileRank(DaytimePopSurgePct))

2. Growth Momentum (30% Weight):
   GM = round(0.55 * PercentileRank(PopGrowth5YrPct) + 0.45 * PercentileRank(PermitsPer1kResidents))

3. Cost Efficiency (25% Weight):
   IRR = MedianHouseholdIncome / (MedianGrossRent * 12)
   CE = round(0.50 * PercentileRank(IRR) + 0.30 * (100 - PercentileRank(UnemploymentRatePct)) + 0.20 * (100 - PercentileRank(FemaRiskIndex)))

4. Regulatory Friction (20% Weight):
   TaxScore = 100 - PercentileRank(CombinedSalesTaxRate)
   WaitScore = max(0, min(100, round(100 - (AvgPermitWaitDays - 14) * 1.2))) [Defaults to 50 if null]
   RF = round(0.65 * TaxScore + 0.35 * WaitScore)

Overall Viability Score = round(0.25 * PP + 0.30 * GM + 0.25 * CE + 0.20 * RF)

### 2.3 Bayesian-Shrunk NAICS Saturation Index
For establishments E and population P:
per10kResidents = (E / P) * 10000
smoothedPer10k = (P * per10kResidents + m * usAvgPer10k) / (P + m) [where m = 10,000 residents prior]
saturationIndex = round((smoothedPer10k / usAvgPer10k) * 100)

## 4. Retail Breakeven Formulas
- Monthly Occupancy Cost = (SqFt * (BaseRentSqFtYr + NnnCamSqFtYr)) / 12
- Monthly Labor Cost = HourlyWage * StaffHoursPerWeek * 4.3482 * (1 + PayrollTaxAndBenefitsLoadPct [0.18])
- Net Ticket Ex-Tax = AvgGrossTicket / (1 + CombinedSalesTaxRate)
- Contribution Margin Per Customer = NetTicketExTax * (1 - CogsPct)
- Monthly Customers Needed = ceil(MonthlyFixedCost / ContributionMarginPerCustomer)
- Daily Customers Needed = ceil(MonthlyCustomersNeeded / 30.4375)
